name: Hourglass
description: The wasp: a knight of the brood built around a waist. Dark green hair in a ponytail down the back under a steel tiara, lids half down, a smirk; a steel cuirass pinched to nothing at the middle and flaring again into tassets banded venom-green and black, the wasp's warning worn as a skirt of plates. Two long clear wings hang folded from the shoulders like a cape, veined, and lift a hair when she breathes. From the near fist, held out, swings the chained head — a Soldier's head-plate packed solid on a cord, hanging and swinging even when the body is still, because a thing that heavy never quite stops. Plated legs, plated forearms, the dead feelers rising from the tiara. Same dead organ as the rest, set in the breastplate. Drawn facing +x; the game flips it.

idle.description: a held stance with the weight on one hip: the chest breathes above the waist and the tassets hardly move under it, the folded wings lift a hair on the in-breath, the ponytail stirs, and the chained head swings from the fist — slower than the body, because it is heavier than the body

walk.description: a stride the hips lead; the wings tilt with each step, the ponytail swings, and the chained head is thrown back and forward on its cord from a fist kept up out of the way
